operating_notes.text: Swasthfit contributed 27% to total revenue in FY26.
Revenue per patient rose to ₹968 in Q1FY27 from ₹880 a year earlier, with CGHS/ECHS price revision contributing 2-3% at company level.
Swasthfit is 27% of revenue and grew about 20% in Q1FY27, in line with overall revenue, so its share was unchanged.
Rural outreach programme is active in 7 states and tested more than 1,10,000 patients in Q1FY27; it is a separate affordable package, not Swasthfit.
PathLabs Unifiers Private Limited acquired the remaining 30% stake in Centrapath Labs Private Limited, making it a wholly owned subsidiary.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹702.7 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹131.3 Cr.
Dr. Lal PathLabs reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹2,763 Cr and PAT of ₹532 Cr.
Vinay Gujral, CFO, shared Q4 & FY26 earnings conference call recording on April 30, 2026, available at **https://www.lalpathlabs.com/investors/investors-inside/quarterly-result**.
Dr. Vandana Lal, Promoter & Whole Time Director, confirms no encumbrance on Dr. Lal PathLabs shares by Promoter Group/PAC during FY2025-26.
Dr. Lal PathLabs reported Q4 FY26 revenue of ₹703 Cr and FY27 early to mid-teens revenue growth guidance during the earnings call on May 6, 2026.

On its 24 July 2026 Q1FY27 call, Dr Lal PathLabs reported revenue of ₹798 Cr (+19.1% YoY) and PAT of ₹170 Cr, declared a ₹5 interim dividend and disclosed board approval of an 80% stake in Ghana's Sunshine Healthcare.
Dr. Lal PathLabs' subsidiary PathLabs Unifiers acquired the remaining 30% stake in Centrapath Labs Private Limited.
